runtime.label: Native runtime proof
runtime.detail: Native input, accessibility control automation, persistence, playback, software postures, CounterLab interaction acceptance, and app-performance checks remain unverified. One iPhone 16 diagnostic render does not verify Duo or iPad behavior.
runtime.faq: Debug and release CounterLab IPAs build with SDK 27.2. A diagnostic iPhone 16 guest has rendered BruTV's native login UI, with the app verified as frontmost. DataMigrator still reports success: false for build 24A446. Clean creation, input, accessibility control automation, persistence, playback, app performance, and Duo/iPad runtime acceptance remain unverified.

workflowNote: Debug and release CounterLab IPAs build with SDK 27.2. BruTV installed, launched, and rendered on an iPhone 16 diagnostic guest; failed migration still blocks creation acceptance.
